ramp-health-probe.label: ramp
ramp-health-probe.config: image 04f3544: readiness probe GET /health (thread pool), 1 s timeout; /recommend in the thread pool

one-pod-thread-pool.label: one-pod
one-pod-thread-pool.config: image c0728c2: readiness probe GET /ready (event loop), 2 s timeout; /recommend in the thread pool; autoscaler pinned to 1 pod
one-pod-thread-pool.cpu_note: cpu_ms_per_request: the pod's cgroup usage_usec over its life, divided by the requests of this run; includes the pod's idle minutes before the run, so it is an upper bound

one-pod-inline.label: one-pod
one-pod-inline.config: image e84c3b0: /recommend ranked on the event loop; readiness GET /ready; 1 vCPU request = limit; autoscaler pinned to 1 pod
one-pod-inline.cpu_note: cpu_ms_per_request: the pod's cgroup usage_usec over its life, divided by the requests of this run; includes the pod's idle minutes before the run, so it is an upper bound

one-pod-burst.label: one-pod-burst
one-pod-burst.config: image c0728c2: /recommend in the thread pool; readiness GET /ready; request 1 vCPU, limit 2 vCPU (Autopilot bursting); autoscaler pinned to 1 pod; applied with kubectl for this run only
one-pod-burst.cpu_note: cpu_ms_per_request: the pod's cgroup usage_usec over its life, divided by the requests of this run; includes the pod's idle minutes before the run, so it is an upper bound

ramp-event-loop-keepalive.label: ramp
ramp-event-loop-keepalive.config: image e84c3b0: /recommend on the event loop; readiness GET /ready (2 s timeout, 3 failures); kept-alive connections; autoscaler 1 to 8 pods at 70% CPU
